name: Ramp
text: Add a visible server-side skip link at the top of every page. It’s the only reliable way to let keyboard users bypass repetitive navigation blocks instantly, without relying on fragile client-side tricks. The trade-off is a tiny extra server load for every page load, but that cost is trivial compared to the accessibility win.

name: Reader
text: A visible server-side skip link forces every user to encounter it, which can be distracting, particularly for those who do not use keyboard navigation. Instead, consider implementing a client-side skip link that activates only when users tab through the page. This balances accessibility needs while reducing clutter for mouse users, addressing both functionality and user experience. To settle the argument, conducting user testing with both methods could provide insight into which option users prefer.
